description: Matched physical exclusion comparisons. All inputs synthetic; all modes retain the same semantic graph and focal definitions.

definitions.depth: Weighted radial penetration, max over foreign ellipses for each node; RMS includes non-intruders as zero. Context and non-shared focal members are separate, with fixed intruders counted independently.
definitions.regions: Identical fitting/padding policy is measured in all modes, including baseline and RFC-only. Region size and link error are retained to expose changing geometry.
definitions.motion: All actual integrations observed. Traces sample batch 1/every tenth batch; their maxima/RMS cover that batch, not the skipped interval. Large means >29.9 Euclidean units.
definitions.startup: Every integration in the first forty steps. Initial impulses are captured after the first TG+RFC force evaluation, before any integration or retained momentum.
definitions.force: Final-coordinate undamped net-force RMS on movable nodes, with momentum cleared, zero global motion and rigidity divided out. Probe cannot move saved positions and does not enter motion totals.
